description: This file defines a PHP class 'SystemCheck' within the 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Util' namespace. The class performs various system environment checks required during the installation or setup phase of the OrangeHRM application, such as verifying PHP version, database server compatibility, database engine support, directory permissions, and extension configurations. It encapsulates logic to validate environment readiness by checking server configurations, PHP extensions, database connectivity and version, as well as file permissions, providing structured results for each check.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: Performs comprehensive system environment checks including server configuration, extension availability, directory writability, and DB engine support to facilitate installation readiness validation.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks whether the current PHP version falls within acceptable ranges defined in system requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Verifies if the MySQL client version meets minimum recommended requirements.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks the MySQL server version for compatibility, differentiating between MySQL and MariaDB.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Checks whether the MySQL engine supports InnoDB.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Validates if the current web server is among supported web server types.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks write permission on configuration directory.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks write permission on cache directory.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks write permission on log directory.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks write permission on crypto keys directory.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Checks maximum session idle time setting.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Verifies whether PHP register_globals is turned off.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Checks the allocated memory limit for PHP scripts.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cURL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SimpleXML extension is enabled.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Zip extension is enabled.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GD extension is enabled.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if intl extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO MySQL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if OpenSSL extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkWritePermission
methods.description: Attempts to write a temporary file to determine directory writability.

methods.name: checkPhpMemory
methods.description: Determines the PHP memory limit and compares it against thresholds.

methods.name: getSizeInBytes
methods.description: Converts PHP memory size notation to bytes.

methods.name: isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if the current version falls within a specified range and not in excluded ranges.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates appropriate error messages based on version checks.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Determines if a version is within an excluded range.

methods.name: getPhpVersion
methods.description: Returns the current PHP version.

methods.name: getWebServerDetails
methods.description: Returns details about the web server.

methods.name: getMysqlClientVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL client version.

methods.name: getMysqlServerVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL server version.

methods.name: getMySqlHostInfo
methods.description: Returns MySQL connection status details.

methods.name: getOSDetails
methods.description: Returns details about the operating system.

methods.name: getPDOConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: getSystemDetails
methods.description: Returns composite system information including OS, PHP, MySQL, and server details.

methods.name: getSystemCheckResults
methods.description: Returns aggregated results of environment checks, formatted for CLI or web.
